player_prompt.intro:
Wi ule wena Muthandeni {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe ya Muvu.
Pa nthanda yako, ungaweka 'X' kapena 'O' mu miraba ya malo.
Ungashinda kwa kuweka malembo matatu ayo ayo (X kapena O) mu mstari.
Ungashinda na malembo yoyose.
Sankha nthanda yako kwa kutumia mfano '[X 4]' kuweka X pakati.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mfano wa nthanda si sahihi. Tumia mfano '[X 4]' kapena '[O 2]'.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Nambari ya seli si sahihi: {cell}. Lazima iwe kati ya 0 na 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Nthanda si sahihi. Seli {cell} tayari iliwekwa.

game_action.placed: Muthandeni {player_id} aliweka chapa yake ({mark}) mu seli {cell}
